sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup and cached land outline
sections.what: Brings in the place data and helpers, and keeps one shared copy of the land outline for every globe on the page.
sections.why: Downloading the outline once and reusing it avoids repeated downloads for each role.
sections.watch_out: The cache lives for the whole page visit and is never cleared.

sections.name: ProjectGlobe (part 1)
sections.title: Start points and projection math
sections.what: Finds the home base and project stops for the role and sets up the math that turns places on Earth into dots on the screen. It also includes a helper that finds the curved path between two places.
sections.why: A flat screen needs this math to show a sphere with curved trip arcs.
sections.watch_out: A place missing from the geo data is silently skipped, so a stop can disappear without an error.

sections.name: ProjectGlobe (part 2)
sections.title: Animation frames and drawing
sections.what: On each frame, slowly turns the view toward the current stop, then draws the land dots, the globe edge, the past trips and the trip in progress.
sections.why: Redrawing everything each frame makes the globe look like it is rotating smoothly.
sections.watch_out: Points on the far side are hidden using a depth value, so changing that cut-off changes what appears at the edge.

sections.name: ProjectGlobe (part 3)
sections.title: Place markers, loading and cleanup
sections.what: Draws the place markers and highlights the current stop. Loads the land outline if it is not cached yet, and stops the animation when the component is removed.
sections.why: Stopping the animation on cleanup keeps it from running after the globe is gone.
sections.watch_out: The loading step has no error handling, so a failed download fails silently.

summary: A small animated dot globe for one job role. It starts at the home office and draws curved travel arcs to each project location, with no text.
purpose: Adds a visual of the travel behind a role, so visitors see where the work happened.
why: Likely reason: a decorative visual that makes the career map feel alive. The code comment says it shows travel only, with no text on top.
how: 1. Looks up the home base and project stops for the role. 2. Loads the land outline once and keeps it for later globes. 3. Draws the globe edge and the land dots. 4. Turns the view toward each stop in turn and draws the arc. 5. Marks each place and repeats. 6. Stops when the component is removed.
inputs: The role name and an optional class name. It reads place coordinates from the geo data file, the land outline from a JSON file under the media folder, and the reduced motion setting.
outputs: A drawing on a canvas. No data is sent or returned.
risks: The land file download has no error handling, so if it fails the globe stays blank without a message. The animation runs every frame, which can be heavy on older phones.
debug: If the globe is blank, check the land file path in the media folder and the browser's network tab. If the stops look wrong, check the role's entry in the geo data. If motion is wrong with reduced motion on, check the motion helper.
